sampling_model.design: Independent multinomial sampling of the complete observed path \(W=(X_1,X_2,X_3,X_4,D)\).
sampling_model.treatment: Binary \(D\), with treatment beginning after date \(2\).
sampling_model.overlap: Every mixing, conditional assignment, and transition probability in the proposal-specific model lies in \([\eta,1-\eta]\).
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: The empirical thirty-two-cell path PMF is inverted over all thirty-two labeled one-collision branches; no relative alignment is selected before projection.

comparator_promise_table.comparator_claim: Proposition 4 identifies the model parameters under RSM, M, and ID; Proposition 5 and Corollary 1 identify LTATT and aggregate ATT under the paper's stated TI--LT regular conditions.
Theorem 1 identifies type-specific initial distributions, transition kernels, and type probabilities up to a common permutation from four consecutive observations under Assumptions 1--3.
Sections 3.2--3.4 formulate model comparison, implicit observable constraints, identification, and bounding for polynomial latent-variable models through real quantifier elimination.
Cylindrical algebraic decomposition gives an exact quantifier-elimination method for formulas over real closed fields.
CAD-based real quantifier elimination has doubly exponential worst-case dependence on dimension, while other real-algebraic methods address selected tasks with different bounds.
A rational inverse and semialgebraic membership conditions characterize regular parts of a single binary hidden Markov model, with exceptional cases treated as lower-dimensional submodels.
Discrete causal bounds can be posed as polynomial programs and approximated by spatial branch-and-bound with certified outer bounds and \(\epsilon\)-sharpness.
Finite mixtures are exactly partially identified under an excluded source of mixture-weight variation using probability restrictions.
Criterion inversion yields confidence regions for identified sets and their images under stated pointwise and uniform conditions.

body.tldr: On the compact binary four-period model, the completed singular result is the exclusive stratum with distinct treated terminal rows and exactly one collided control terminal row. Terminal splitting reduces its forty-coordinate labeled fiber to sixteen ten-variable orientation/alignment charts for each collided state. A corrected full Collins certificate projects every pair in the complete polynomial family and exactly decides branch feasibility and aggregate-ATT constancy, including zero and box-face cells; it is a generic exact certificate, not the still-open compressed economic sign basis. The exact algorithm returns the attained, possibly disconnected sharp image with endpoint witnesses. Full-PMF inversion is uniformly honest in finite samples and remains auxiliary; no endpoint or Hausdorff consistency is claimed. An injective one-parameter family has two separated quotient ATT values, proving positive-dimensional persistence but not relative openness in a larger collision variety.

project_justification.gap: Ahn--Kasahara's parameter and ATT identification results impose their stated regular conditions, while Higgins and Jochmans require rank, type-separation, and connectivity conditions. Neither classifies aggregate ATT on the exclusive one-collided-control-row fiber. General Collins quantifier elimination can decide polynomial formulas, but an incomplete projection subfamily cannot certify simultaneous structural equalities, and generic CAD does not itself supply the causal chart reduction or a compressed economic diagnostic.
project_justification.niche: Exactly one collided control terminal row is the first completed nonregular stratum here: full-path terminal splitting, rank failure, compact-box contact, and the two relative cross-arm alignments interact but reduce to ten coordinates. The result deliberately does not claim the other fifteen terminal-collision patterns of a global atlas.
project_justification.fill: The project proves the corrected arm-label-aware ten-coordinate reconstruction, uses a complete all-pairs Collins projection certificate to classify feasibility and point identification on that stratum, computes its exact attained ATT image, and supplies auxiliary finite-sample full-PMF coverage. A separate injective one-parameter family proves persistent two-value ambiguity. Compression of the complete certificate to a smaller irredundant observable basis remains open.

body.related_work: Ahn--Kasahara is the closest econometric comparator in the same full-path latent-transition architecture; its regular identification results motivate the estimand and factorization here. The compact class \(\mathcal M_\eta\) and its exclusive one-collision stratum are not asserted to equal, contain, or extend that published identification class. Higgins and Jochmans give a four-observation Markov-mixture benchmark under rank, separation, and connectivity conditions but do not classify a two-arm one-collision alignment fiber. Critch motivates algebraic treatment of binary hidden Markov laws but has neither treatment-arm alignment nor this causal functional. Geiger--Meek and Collins provide generic real quantifier elimination; after correction, the paper uses the complete all-pairs projection machinery only after its model-specific forty-to-ten reduction and claims no generic complexity gain or compressed sign basis. Duarte and coauthors motivate polynomial causal bounds, whereas the object here is an exact attained semialgebraic image. Romano--Shaikh motivates identified-set inference; the present finite-sample inversion is auxiliary and makes no Hausdorff or endpoint-consistency claim.
body.interpretation: A reported ATT sign on this merger stratum is identified only when the complete two-copy certificate rejects every feasible unequal-ATT pair across all orientations and both relative alignments. Otherwise the estimand is the attained set itself, which may be disconnected and must not be replaced by its convex hull. The exact certificate is suitable as a backend audit trail; a short economically interpretable front-end diagnostic remains an open compression problem.
body.technical_internal_limitation: The completed algebra covers only laws whose entire compact fiber has distinct treated terminal rows and exactly one specified collided control terminal row. The certificate has now been repaired to project equality--equality and every other polynomial pair, but it remains full Collins quantifier elimination and may have its generic worst-case cost. No endpoint, Hausdorff, or branch-persistence consistency theorem is claimed. The positive-dimensional benchmark is one explicit affine family and is not claimed relatively open in the full collision variety.
body.honest_scope: Completed claims are quotient invariance, the corrected forty-to-ten one-collision reduction, the complete thirty-two-branch feasibility and ATT-constancy certificate across both collided states, the exact attained stratum-restricted region, the explicit positive-dimensional two-value family, and uniformly honest finite-sample full-PMF inversion. No result is claimed for the other terminal-collision strata, for an unboxed singular class, for a global sixteen-collision-pattern atlas, for relative openness of the benchmark family, or for Hausdorff or ordered-endpoint consistency. The complete certificate is not advertised as the model-specific compressed vanishing/sign test requested by the broader agenda; strict sufficient and irredundant compression remains the open question. No overlap, inclusion, or extension relation with Ahn--Kasahara's regular identification class is claimed.
